name: AI Image Enhancer
tagline: AI Image Enhancer started as a simple upscaling tool and grew into a full photo editing suite
description: AI Image Enhancer started as a simple upscaling tool and grew into a full photo editing suite. Right now it covers seven core tools: image enhancement (sharpening, denoising, 2x/4x upscaling), background removal with replacement options, old photo restoration with colorization, object removal via brush-based inpainting, face swap, hairstyle try-on, and anime-style conversion. The workflow is intentionally simple — upload, process, download. No Photoshop skills required. Batch mode lets you queue
